Question:
\(PA\) is tangent to circle \(O\) at \(A\). What is the measure of \(\angle OAP\)? (Unit: degrees)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_262_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: A tangent is perpendicular to the radius through the point of tangency, so \(\angle OAP=90^\circ\).
